q: Motion can be described or analyzed conveniently with the help of graphs.
e: True. Motion can be described or analyzed conveniently with the help of graphs. Every quantity named in that sentence is being used in its physics sense.

q: The motion graphs are of three types: displacement-time graph, velocity-time graph, and acceleration-time graph.
e: True. The motion graphs are of three types: displacement-time graph, velocity-time graph, and acceleration-time graph. Displacement can be smaller than the path if the path bends.

q: The motion graphs are of four types.
e: False. The main motion graphs are three: displacement-time, velocity-time, and acceleration-time. Displacement can be smaller than the path if the path bends.

q: The slope of the s-t graph gives the constant velocity.
e: True. The slope of the s-t graph gives the constant velocity. Velocity is directed. Speed is the size of that velocity.

q: Of three types of motion graphs, the s-t graph is very useful to analyze a motion.
e: False. Of three types of motion graphs, the v-t graph is very useful to analyze a motion. This claim used s-t in place of v-t.

q: Of three types of motion graphs, the v-t graph is very useful to analyze a motion.
e: True. Of three types of motion graphs, the v-t graph is very useful to analyze a motion. Every quantity named in that sentence is being used in its physics sense.

q: The slope of a v-t graph gives the velocity of a body.
e: False. The slope of a v-t graph gives the acceleration of a body. This claim used velocity in place of acceleration.

q: The slope of a v-t graph gives the acceleration of a body.
e: True. The slope of a v-t graph gives the acceleration of a body. Acceleration is not velocity. It is how velocity is changing.

q: The area under a v-t graph gives the velocity of a body.
e: False. The slope of a v-t graph gives the acceleration of a body. This claim used area under velocity in place of slope of acceleration.

q: The area under a v-t graph gives the displacement or distance moved by the body.
e: True. The area under a v-t graph gives the displacement or distance moved by the body. Displacement can be smaller than the path if the path bends.

q: A negative slope on a v-t graph indicates positive acceleration.
e: False. A negative slope on a v-t graph indicates negative acceleration or retardation. This claim used positive acceleration in place of negative acceleration or retardation.

q: A negative slope on a v-t graph indicates negative acceleration or retardation.
e: True. A negative slope on a v-t graph indicates negative acceleration or retardation. Acceleration is not velocity. It is how velocity is changing.
